query: why does electricity not get inside a metal box

payload.answer: Electricity does not get inside a metal box because the electric field is zero everywhere inside any conductor in a static situation [1]. This happens because free charges move until they cancel out any internal field, resulting in no net charge at any point inside the material [1]. Consequently, there is no potential difference between points inside or on the surface, meaning no work is done moving a test charge within the box [1].
